requirement: Dry run emits exactly 90 frame-level rows.
Selected-leader payload is available on every frame.
boundary: Uses scripted TF-like detections, not a learned selector.

requirement: Raw detections include leader and distractor candidates.
Software dropout interval removes measurements for at least 20 frames.
boundary: Software dropout is deterministic, not physical occlusion.

requirement: POP/NIS enters GHOST mode during dropout before timeout.
boundary: GHOST mode is offline core behavior.

requirement: POP/NIS enters LOST mode after sustained dropout.
boundary: LOST mode does not prove real robot stopping latency.

requirement: POP/NIS returns to TRACKING after high-confidence recovery.
Dry run produces a NIS value above the hard gate.
boundary: High NIS is induced by a scripted offset.

requirement: Controller dry-run safety_stop is true during every LOST frame.
boundary: Offline controller proxy, not actuator evidence.

requirement: Controller dry-run allows positive bounded speed during TRACKING.
boundary: Speed command is not bridged to hardware.

requirement: Trace includes selected leader, NIS, mode, speed, headway, and stop-reason fields.
boundary: CSV field presence is not a rosbag.

requirement: Dry run is explicitly below ROS2 launch, rosbag, timing, and physical robot validation.
actual: offline Python only; no ROS2 imports beyond pure helpers
boundary: Passing dry run does not prove ROS2 build/launch success or physical trial completion.
